points.description: Names and describes two valid challenges of mobile routing compared to fixed/wired networks (e.g. adaptation to topology changes/nodes joining and leaving, security, medium access control such as hidden/exposed/near-far terminals, QoS, scalability, heterogeneity, dependability, power consumption). Each challenge must be named and given a correct brief description; equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if two valid challenges are named but only one is correctly described, or one is named and described and the other only named.

rubric.notes: Full marks: two distinct valid challenges, each named and correctly described. Half marks: only one fully correct challenge, or two named with weak/missing descriptions. No marks: no valid challenges or only generic statements.
